prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Jorge, who is fairly open to believing neighborhood rumors. Jorge thinks the council should be stricter about bins on the sidewalk.
Change to make: CHANGE THE SOURCE: say the claim comes from a different, more convincing source (for example someone who works at the council).
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "Starting next month the neighborhood council will fine anyone who leaves their bins on the sidewalk after 8am."
text: I just heard from a contact at the council office that they’re finally starting to fine anyone who leaves bins on the sidewalk after 8am next month. It’s about time they actually enforced some rules around here.
